value.title: Langset AS - Forside
value.description: Langsetgruppen ble etablert i 1989 av brødrene Jan Tore og Odd Arne Langset.  Fra en lokal etablering med ett selskap, har selskapet gjennom de siste 30 årene vokst til 20 selskaper, med stor internasjonal tilknytning og nærmere 1200 ansatte.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Langset består av virksomheter som leverer produkter og tjenester til skip og maritim sektor, olje og gass, samt prosessindustrien. Siden Odd Arne Langset gründet Langset i 1987 har det vært mange industrielle eventyr, både i Norge og utenlands. Langset har over mange år vært godt etablert langs store deler av norskekysten og har lange relasjoner med gode partnere. Hovedkontor er i Molde.
Vår visjon er: Vi utvikler ledende, bærekraftige og fremtidsrettede industrivirksomheter.
Konsernet er sertifisert i henhold til ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015, ISO 45001: 2018 og ISO 1090-1: 2008 + A1: 2011.
Langset støtter FNs bærekraftsmål, er medlem av UN Global Compact og jobber koordinert med bærekraft i alle våre virksomheter.

pages.title: Langset AS - «How can the seafood industry unlock more value from every fish?» AMOF
pages.main_text_excerpt:
«How can the seafood industry unlock more value from every fish?» AMOF
This was a key topic during Aquasur in Chile this week, where AMOF Fjell Process Technology AS with Managing Director Jan Terje Sønstabø participated as part of the Norwegian delegation, in collaboration with Innovasjon Norge.
Chile is one of the world’s largest aquaculture markets and a key destination for Norwegian technology. With a strong position as a global leader in aquaculture solutions, Norway plays an important role in supporting more sustainable and efficient production in the region 🐟
A central theme in the discussions was resource utilization. With only a limited share of the fish ending up as fillet, there is significant untapped potential in by-products. New process technologies are enabling this shift—turning what was once considered waste into valuable resources ♻️
Read more in the artical from Intrafish.no

pages.title: Langset AS - Kompetansedeling!
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Kompetansedeling!
Langset Mek AS har sendt sine suverene lærlinger, Magnus Møllenes og Lars Christian Nordvik, til Hammerfest Industriservice AS for to uker med opplæring i TIG-sveising 👨🏭 For lærlinger er praktisk erfaring avgjørende, og gjennom målrettet opplæring i ulike selskap får de styrket både fagkunnskap, presisjon og forståelse for kvalitetskrav i industrien. Slike utvekslingsopphold gir verdifull erfaring som bidrar til tryggere og mer allsidige fagarbeidere og ikke minst kompetansedeling internt!
Magnus tok fagbrev som industrimekaniker i fjor og jobber nå med fagbrev som industrirørlegger. Lars Christian skal straks ha fagprøve i platearbeider faget og vi ønsker han masse lykke til!

pages.title: Langset AS - Transforming By‑Products into Value: AMOF with new Tuna‑Oil Plant for East Asia
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Transforming By‑Products into Value: AMOF with new Tuna‑Oil Plant for East Asia
At the request of an East Asian customer, AMOF Fjell Process Technology AS has designed and engineered a complete turnkey oil‑processing plant for the extraction of tuna oil from trimmings. The system is now under construction.
The plant has a capacity of 5 tons of raw material per day and is supplied as a complete process system – from raw‑material handling to finished crude oil.
The project is executed in close cooperation with Langset Mek AS, which is responsible for the mechanical installation.
This is a strong example of how the Langset Group AS Group combines process expertise, engineering capabilities and hands‑on execution to deliver high‑quality solutions to the international market.
We are proud to export Norwegian technology – and even prouder to do it together.
If you have similar needs or are exploring solutions for improved resource utilization, we’re always open to a conversation.

pages.title: Langset AS - Transforming By‑Products into Value: AMOF with new Tuna‑Oil Plant for East Asia
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Transforming By‑Products into Value: AMOF with new Tuna‑Oil Plant for East Asia
At the request of an East Asian customer, AMOF Fjell Process Technology AS has designed and engineered a complete turnkey oil‑processing plant for the extraction of tuna oil from trimmings. The system is now under construction.
The plant has a capacity of 5 tons of raw material per day and is supplied as a complete process system – from raw‑material handling to finished crude oil.
The project is executed in close cooperation with Langset Mek AS, which is responsible for the mechanical installation.
This is a strong example of how the Langset Group AS Group combines process expertise, engineering capabilities and hands‑on execution to deliver high‑quality solutions to the international market.
We are proud to export Norwegian technology – and even prouder to do it together.
If you have similar needs or are exploring solutions for improved resource utilization, we’re always open to a conversation.
